# mockware

> Generate mock SDK layers for embedded unit testing from YAML templates.

## Key links

- Repository: https://github.com/Ronika-Co/Mockware
- Documentation: https://ronika-co.github.io/Mockware/
- YAML reference: https://ronika-co.github.io/Mockware/yaml-reference.html
- Test patterns: https://ronika-co.github.io/Mockware/test-patterns.html

## What is mockware?

mockware is a CLI tool that takes a YAML template describing external
SDK headers and generates compilable mock implementations. It supports:

- C functions with overridable function pointers
- C++ classes with virtual methods (override in tests)
- Namespaces, enums, macros, typedefs, struct definitions
- Nested paths (e.g., "driver/gpio.h" creates include/driver/gpio.h)

## Quick start

```bash
# Download a pre-built binary from GitHub Releases:
# https://github.com/Ronika-Co/Mockware/releases
#
# Or run directly from source:
git clone https://github.com/Ronika-Co/Mockware.git
cd Mockware

# Generate mock SDK from a directory of templates
uv run mockware generate templates/ -o mock-sdk

# Or from individual files
uv run mockware generate esp.yml freertos.yml -o mock-sdk
```

Then compile your tests with `-I mock-sdk/include` and link `mock-sdk/source/*.c`.

## Example YAML

```yaml
headers:
  "esp_err.h":
    macros:
      ESP_OK: "0"
    types:
      esp_err_t: int
  "driver/gpio.h":
    includes: ["esp_err.h"]
    functions:
      gpio_set_level:
        return: esp_err_t
        params: ["int pin", "int level"]
```

## C mocking pattern

```c
#include "mockware/fakes.h"
void test_gpio() {
    gpio_set_level_mock = &my_stub;
    gpio_set_level(1, 1);  // calls my_stub
}
```

## C++ mocking pattern

```cpp
struct MockSensor : public drivers::TemperatureSensor {
    float read() override { return 42.0f; }
};
```
